updated_tickets.description:
Review subtask of EVAL02 #10996, preserving its unexecuted qualified-intervention requirement.

Inventory the original Vanilla/V1–V4 comparison, narrow/broad-Pt development comparison, broad source competence, later correction evaluation and the separate EVAL02 34-layout panel. Identify model/data lineage, endpoint, eligible denominator, family/seed dependence, prior exposure and exact existing inference.

Required distinctions
Manipulation versus already-completed preservation; original centring criterion versus labelled post-hoc square placement; source checks versus generalization; frozen development protocol versus untouched confirmation; correction data versus additional optimization. Preserve original cluster/Holm grouping and multiplicity. Gains and losses separately when available.

Deliverables
One comparison ledger and one short claim-status report. Reproduce existing counts/uncertainty only from available pinned inputs; do not choose a new test after seeing results. Missing evidence is a named gap, not zero success.

Forbidden
No new training, physics rollouts, scenario generation, annotation, observer work, pod restarts, split changes or replacement evaluations.

Branch research/eval02-comparison-review. Review closure does not claim completion of the original 204-rollout plan; the qualified intervention arm remains unresolved.

updated_tickets.title: VIDEO01 — Compare video-derived representations and robot adapters without geometric-expert trajectories
updated_tickets.description:
User request12October: add an OST experiment to understand a generic robot encoder and compare methods driven by personal video, not the existing geometric teacher.

Interpretation
Separate the human-video representation from the robot-specific action decoder/controller. A universal robot encoder is a hypothesis, not an existing component. Keep original footage and frozen models/results unchanged.

Arms
A: track object-centric motion, directed orientation and observable contact events from phone frames.
B: track hand/pinch motion and aperture from phone frames, with uncertainty through occlusion.
C: use frozen pretrained visual features over the actual human sequence to represent temporal progress/subgoals; test whether they preserve task-relevant motion across views and distinguish correction from completion.
Existing endpoint/geometric expert is a labelled comparator only, not labels or trajectory generator forA/B/C.

Acceptance
Audit actual available calibration, synchronization and source split. Preserve full source timestamps and feature provenance. Run paired-view correspondence, temporal reversal/shuffle/static-video negative controls, and held-out take/view tests. Where justified, retarget one observed trajectory to Panda using only declared calibration, robot kinematics/controller and task-independent feasibility constraints. Record every supplied constant. Do not invent metric3D, hand contacts or robot-action labels from2D. If calibration blocks motor execution, report the representation-level result and blocker explicitly rather than silently substituting teacher waypoints.

Generalisation
Distinguish representation reuse across layouts/views from motor transfer to another robot. Freeze any second-robot or novel-layout test before execution. No new paid compute, no model upgrade or publication.

Output
New isolated results under /var/tmp/typhon-video-representation-20261012; mirror to Mint Fast Drive. Add an experiment and corresponding result box in OST, with individual arm findings.

12 October implementation update
Created and pushed isolated GitHub branches/worktrees for all three arms. Source freeze reverified all eight raw recordings and 526 sampled phone frames from 16 takes. A: 440 accepted centres, 227/264 accepted primary orientations; B: 175/526 sampled frames contain detected hands, with grasp unknown; C: 526 frozen 1024D visual descriptors, pooled paired-take retrieval 1/16, timing/shuffle/reversal controls retained. No geometric-expert trajectories or robot truth supplied to these methods. Initial extraction artifacts are ready for review. No new VLA training or robot execution has occurred.

Still outstanding
Dense contact/phase accuracy checks, correction/completion representation tests on held-out takes, calibrated/declared robot adapter and any transfer claim. Metric global depth/lift and contacts remain unresolved. Keep this parent In Progress; do not mark the broad generic-encoder hypothesis complete.

Backup
Research branches are private on GitHub. Bulk checkpoints/media/rollouts go to Mint Fast Drive with SHA-256 manifests. Powerglide reservation AAE1BB6A was checked live: expires Tuesday 13 October 2026 01:00 BST.

VIDEO02 corrected continuation, 12 October 2026
Dense extraction, cropped/full frozen features, four-second observed anchors and QA are under #11019. Report: https://github.com/NatMota/typhon-robotics/blob/research/video01-temporal-validation/experiment-history/2026-10-12-video02/REPORT.md. Independent sequential raw decoding caught 906 frame-content/index mismatches in the first dense-v1 export; it is preserved and superseded. Corrected dense-v2 decodes from frame zero and passes all 2,644 raw frame-content hashes. Recomputed full/crop fusion reduces offline paired-camera timing error 2.090 to 1.205 s; 13/16 takes improve. Ordered full-image take retrieval improves 1/16 to 7/16. This is exploratory offline matching with future frames available, not live control or task success. Crops enlarge glyph support but crop-only matching is worse. No GE trajectories, model updates, robot-action labels or new robot episodes. Next: validate contact/depth/calibration for the separate Panda adapter. The broad transfer/encoder task is unresolved.

VIDEO03 continuation, 12 October 2026 (#11020)
A direct phone-video observation probe was fitted from P_train reviewed held intervals; no GE actions, crosshair input or motor-policy changes. 155/155 conservative validation interiors agree, but the hand-present challenge exposes false held states: full image 5/8 views; full+crop/temporal 2/8. Primary-to-secondary recall is 28/28 with full+crop but 23/28 after adding history. History removes 12 false positives in a different recording-shift panel; effects are mixed and do not establish reliable contact. Correction positive labels vanish under 0.25 s uncertainty erosion. 35 fresh refits reproduce bitwise. Report: https://github.com/NatMota/typhon-robotics/blob/research/video03-held-probe/experiment-history/2026-10-12-video03/REPORT.md
Next: training-only hard negatives and better contact transition labels with new event holdouts, before any controller authority or Panda retargeting. The generic encoder/Panda adapter remains unresolved.

VIDEO04 continuation, 12 October 2026 (#11021)
Training-only hand-present negatives tested: six withdrawal events / 12 new views, five training approaches remain unknown. All 90 held interiors retained. Extra transition false-held views 2/6 to 1/6, but the same approach event remains wrong (1/3 events); old challenge 2/4 to 1/4 failing events. Six refits reproduce bitwise; no extra discrete benefit from negative reweighting or history. This supports targeted withdrawal label repair, not contact authority or robot transfer. Next: training-only pre-contact, supported-pause and failed-grasp evidence; use independent event evaluation. Report: https://github.com/NatMota/typhon-robotics/blob/research/video04-contact-negatives/experiment-history/2026-10-12-video04/REPORT.md

Video-to-Panda adapter remains unresolved under #10989/#10991. Next independent OST experiment: LIVE04 #11014 delayed candidate handoff; video evidence remains preserved.

VIDEO08 continuation,13October2026 (#11032)
The inherited target-plane annotation does not identify unique camera geometry. All297 tested intrinsic settings per view have a compatible PnP fit within5px, despite camera-height ranges3.91–23.77 /2.42–14.65 target-side units. Nominal exact centred focal constraints conflict. Hypothetical off-plane predictions spread55.12/101.03px across alternative pose branches; retaining lowest-error branch per intrinsic gives4.95/11.48px. These are sensitivity hypotheses, not independent trials or confidence intervals. Ten analysis artifacts reproduce byte-for-byte; exact synthetic pinhole/projection/rotation checks pass. Report: https://github.com/NatMota/typhon-robotics/blob/research/video08-calibration-identifiability/experiment-history/2026-10-13-video08/REPORT.md
This rejects promoting existing M0 homographies into3D labels, not normalized image-space retargeting or all shape-prior methods. Planner Hmchallengp2 asked for a single next execution-level test with endpoint-only/shuffle/static controls. No VLA training or robot actions run.

VIDEO09 #11033 completed 13 October: complete native human correction video drove five Panda executions (four conditions plus exact repeat). All grasped/lifted/released stably; strict success 0/5. Endpoint registration implies 27.1 mm centre error; initial body/glyph feature mismatch and invalid post-release support plane were identified. Whole-timeline observer gains are unqualified. Intermediate video affects physical motion, but advantage over endpoint/static control is not established. No generated action labels approved for training. VIDEO10 #11034 completed, 13 October
One rigid registration of all 228 native human glyph descriptors to an offline RGB goal, plus 14 extra RGB alignment ticks before the source clock, made all five matched correction executions pass unchanged strict placement. The same 142-command supplied prefix was replayed in every condition. Observer position RMSE improves 38.06% versus END and 48.14% versus STATIC on 184/196 common-valid pre-release timestamps. Independent projected-asset diagnostics do not confirm physical path superiority; STATIC has better yaw tracking. All 108 post-release coordinates per run are unknown, with raw detections retained. The capped offline audit covers all 736 common observations, with zero actor executions or physics rollouts. The assumed secondary-camera plane is about 2.949 mm above the logged printed face. Its fixed-pixel shift (about 0.075 normalized units) nearly matches the observer/fixed-landmark discrepancy (about 0.076 units), with direction cosine above 0.999. The signed cross-term explains why similar bias magnitudes reverse rankings.
An independent check of 56 decorative geoms identifies a 120-micrometre scorer-height discrepancy; correcting that diagnostic leaves END and STATIC ahead. Exact visible/full-support verification remains unqualified: 8/16 selected states have only compressed frames, 8 have no frame, and none has saved native RGB/hash or a full render cache. Eight human frames were redecoded and hash-verified.
Decision: close this measurement branch. Retain successful assisted correction, but do not claim a full-sequence physical-path advantage or automatically start another controller/training run. All 552 VIDEO10 files remain unchanged; 75 audit files are verified on Mint.
